requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that an exact specialty match returns a score of 1.0.
The system must execute unit tests validating that a partial specialty match returns a score strictly between 0 and 1.
The system must execute unit tests validating that a non-matching specialty returns a score of 0.
The system must validate that scoring logic produces consistent outputs for identical inputs across multiple test runs.
The system must include unit tests covering providers with multiple specialties and verify the highest relevance score is selected.
The system must include unit tests for ambiguous user queries and verify that inferred matches produce non-zero scores when appropriate.
The system must execute integration tests validating that evaluate_care_facade returns specialty score fields in the response payload.
The system must validate via integration tests that the specialty score output conforms to the schema defined in EVAL-SPC-001.
The system must verify through integration tests that specialty scoring is triggered during provider evaluation requests.
The system must fail tests if specialty scoring returns null or missing required fields.
The system must include an exception test where an empty or null user query results in a score of 0 without system failure.
The system must include an exception test where provider specialty data is missing and verify the system returns a score of 0 and valid response structure.
The system must validate that LLM-assisted vector expansion produces deterministic specialty candidates for the same input.
The system must validate that LLM-derived specialty expansions do not introduce specialties outside the NUCC taxonomy set.
The system must verify that LLM-assisted matching improves or equals baseline regex-only scoring in partial match scenarios.
The system must ensure LLM-related scoring paths are covered by tests with mocked responses to avoid external dependency during test execution.
